fileReference.name: filename
fileReference.documentation: The file's name with extension, without a directory (e.g. 'Opossum.tissue.gef').

fileReference.name: originalPath
fileReference.documentation: The full path the file was read from, if it is worth recording. It is a hint about where the file was, not a promise about where it is: paths do not survive being moved between machines, which is why the checksum rather than this field identifies the file.

fileReference.name: formatOntology
fileReference.documentation: The ontology node describing the file format in the form of ontology:nodeID (e.g 'EMPTY:0000002'). Empty when not known; a wrong term is worse than none because it is machine-readable and will be believed.

fileReference.name: dateCreated
fileReference.documentation: The time the file was created, as a datenum. The file's own date, not the date the document was made.

fileReference.name: dateUpdated
fileReference.documentation: The time the file was last updated, as a datenum.

fileReference.name: fileSize
fileReference.documentation: The file's size in bytes, or 0 if it was not recorded. A cheap second identifying field: two files that differ in size are certainly not the same file, and it is readable without opening the file.

fileReference.name: checksum
fileReference.documentation: The checksum of the file's contents, in the algorithm named by checksumAlgorithm. Empty when it was not computed; empty means unknown and never means the file had no content.

fileReference.name: checksumAlgorithm
fileReference.documentation: The algorithm the checksum was computed with, so a future reader can verify it without guessing. 'MD5' is what ndi.fun.file.MD5 produces.
